evidence.title: Claude Design: visuals in je huisstijl zonder designer

name: Claude Design: flyers, slides en visuals in je huisstijl, zonder designer
summary: Dutch blog article on Claude Design: what it makes, what it costs and the 12 video lessons that go with it.
description: A Dutch-language article introducing Claude Design, Anthropic's design workspace at claude.ai/design where you chat to produce flyers, slides, landing pages, social visuals and mockups. It walks through the three-step workflow (set up a design system, describe the ask, refine), where the tool sits in Claude's Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise plans, how it compares with Canva, and what the 12 Someflex video lessons cover.
contains: explains the chat + canvas workflow with a reusable design system
pricing: included in paid Claude plans (Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise), no free version
comparison table Claude Design vs Canva
